items.source: Set the MessageListener event messages will be published to.
items.translation: 设置将发布到MessageListener事件的messages。

items.source: Set the resume token (typically a BsonDocument containing a binary token) after which to start with listening.
items.translation: 设置恢复令牌（通常是一个包含binary token的BsonDocument），从此处开始监听。

items.source: Set the name of the MongoCollection to listen to.
Set the name of the MongoDatabase to listen to.
items.translation: 将要监听的MongoDatabase的名称设置为此值。

items.source: Set the FullDocumentBeforeChange lookup to the given value.

Set the cursors maximum wait time on the server (for a new Document to be emitted).
items.translation: 在服务器上设置游标的最大等待时间（用于新文档的发布）。

items.source: Set the resume token after which to continue emitting notifications.
items.translation: 设置恢复令牌，用于继续发出通知。

items.source: Set the cluster time at which to resume listening.
items.translation: 设置恢复监听时的集群时间。

items.source: Set whether expanded change events (e.g. createIndexes, shardCollection) should be emitted.
items.translation: 设置是否应发出扩展变更事件（例如 createIndexes、shardCollection）。
